verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a ClickUp dashboards or widgets capability. The product feature list covers Time Tracking, Whiteboards, Automations, Sprints, Docs, Chat and Proofing, but not Dashboards. The MCP 'build executive reports' item is AI-generated text summaries, the analytics entry (intdir-17) is a third-party integration, and the Views API is an adjacent feature, so none of these count toward building dashboards and widgets.
